question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's consolidated authority within the Chinese Communist Party and People's Liberation Army underpins the 95.5% trader consensus that he will remain in office through the end of 2026. Recent military leadership changes, including the removal of senior generals in early 2026, have reinforced rather than eroded his position, while preparations for a fourth term at the 2027 Party Congress signal continuity over transition. No designated successor has emerged, internal factional challenges remain suppressed, and institutional controls limit the scope for rapid leadership shifts. Although abrupt health developments or unforeseen elite realignments could theoretically alter the timeline, current structures and recent personnel actions make such outcomes appear remote to market participants.
